verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a 'fixed' error status (bugsnag-docs-28), release-level tracking of which release introduced an error (bugsnag-docs-4, bugsnag-docs-25), and alert delivery via Slack and PagerDuty (bugsnag-docs-7, bugsnag-docs-8, bugsnag-docs-9). These are the building blocks of regression alerting, but nothing in the pack shows that a fixed error reopening in a newer release triggers its own alert. Missing for 10: documented regression/reopen detection for fixed errors, a regression notification separate from new-issue alerts, release-aware reopening logic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
